comment: Independent monmove.c monflee() release of a holding monster. A debug-mode Valkyrie wishes for a clove of garlic and creates a large mimic, which hides as hiking boots to her north-west. She walks into it and is stuck to it, then eats the garlic. eat.c garlic_breath() scares the adjacent mimic through monflee(), whose release_hero() calls mon.c unstuck(): 'You get released!' and unstuck()'s rnd(2) re-hold cooldown.
